label: Zalawadi

names.text: "Tara Bakari" is from the Wikipedia article, read on WebFetch.

about.text: A goat breed from Gujarat in western India, kept for milk, meat and fibre. It is long-legged, mostly black, and often bears twins.

sources.text: Wikipedia article, read on WebFetch: Gujarat, milk, meat and fibre uses, the long-legged black coat, and twinning in about 55% of births.

origin.place: The Surendranagar and Rajkot regions of Gujarat, India. The article gives no formation dates.

sources.text: Wikipedia article, read on WebFetch: the Surendranagar and Rajkot regions. No formation dates are given, so none are used.
Wikipedia article, read on WebFetch: "Milk, meat, and fiber".

facts.v: The article reports a milk yield of 2.02 ± 0.18 kg over 197.2 ± 5.8 days of lactation, with an average productive life of 5 to 6 lactations. The unit looks doubtful for a goat, so it is not used as a per-lactation figure.

links.name: Kappa casein gene polymorphism in Zalawadi goats (IJBT 10(2), 235-237)

sources.text: Figures as the Wikipedia article gives them, read on WebFetch; the cited paper was not opened, so the unit could not be checked.

facts.v: About 55% of births are twins, and about 2% are triplets.

gaps: No head count: the article gives only 27.8% of the goats in Surendranagar, with no year, and it cites an archived ILRI page that was not opened. No DAD-IS risk status (the article does not mention one). No formation dates. No sourced per-lactation yield in kg, because the reported 2.02 kg figure looks like a unit error. The item's parent was given as sheep, but the breed is a goat, so it is written under goat.
